publicKey.description: 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding

routerPublicKey.description: 32-byte routing-Worker Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding

mergeExecutorCommand.description: Required when a public repository explicitly enables merge-pull; receives only typed bounded JSON on stdin.

actionsSummaryPath.description: Absolute normalized path to the short-lived redacted Actions summary in the gateway account's mode-0700 directory. Same-account files are mode 0600; the packaged fixed path also accepts root:gateway-group mode 0640. Required when a repository explicitly enables actions-status.

actionsControlPath.description: Absolute normalized path to the gateway-owned control queue: a real (non-symlink) directory named actions-control, owned by the gateway's effective UID/GID with mode 0700. The gateway stores router-signed Actions control envelopes there for the executor to verify and consume. Required when a repository explicitly enables actions-control, which in turn requires actions-status. See operations/mirror-actions-control.md.

privateReplicaStore.description: Owner-only directory containing only 64-hex .fm-private ciphertext envelopes

dynamicRepositoriesPath.description: Absolute normalized path to the node-owned fork registry (type forkmesh.dynamic-repositories). Its validated entries are merged as pin-less public repositories; an invalid registry or entry is skipped, never fatal.

dashboard.description: Serve the same-codebase web dashboard from the mirrored assets repository's build-output blobs, plus the read-only /api subset the logged-out UI needs.

assetsRepository.description: owner/name of an enabled public repository whose app/public and www/public build outputs are served (normally forkmesh/forkmesh).

canonicalOrigin.description: Optional canonical control-plane origin that /login and /signup redirect to.

sshOrigin.description: Optional ssh://git@host[:port] origin advertised as each repository's sshUrl.

replicaPath.description: Optional absolute service-owned path for the validated last-good public dashboard projection bundle. Requires canonicalOrigin.

writableRepositoryRoot.description: Owner-controlled absolute real directory under which an authorized first push may create <owner>/<repo>.git for owners listed in writableOwners.

writableOwners.description: Owners whose repositories may be created on first capability-authorized push; requires writableRepositoryRoot. The single entry "*" accepts every owner the control plane authorized, which is what a node hosting website-created repositories needs; it may not be mixed with named owners.

policyPath.description: Owner-only node operator policy file (see docs/operations/node-operator-policy.md); validated at load and re-read by the pre-receive hook on every push.

stateDirectory.description: Owner-only directory holding the policy hook, quarantine markers, evidence metadata, cases, archived policies and the hash-chained audit log.

operatorPolicy.description: Opt-in node-local storage and legal-response policy. Pushes are checked by a gateway-owned pre-receive hook (repository hooks still never run), quarantined repositories are unavailable on this node only, and private replicas follow seeding.privateReplicas. Requires node_operator_policy.py beside the gateway.

receiveMaxInputBytes.description: receive.maxInputSize applied to git receive-pack --stateless-rpc, and the largest receive-pack POST body the gateway reads under a verified router capability. Defaults to 268435456 (256 MiB).
